steps.name: publish: git lfs track + commit + push uploads the object through the batch API
consume: fresh clone + git lfs pull downloads the exact bytes
same-endpoint write then read: second object pushed and fetched
delete: DELETE objects/{oid} then the object cannot be downloaded
delete/unlist: management API delete of the second object
remote pull-through: git-lfs adapter has no remote source support
steps.detail: not supported: internal/gitlfs README lists remote pull-through as a remaining gate
